headline: Avalanche’s Josh Manson will ‘miss some time’ with lower-body injury
take:
Daily Faceoff reports that Colorado's Josh Manson will "miss some time" with a lower-body injury after leaving Wednesday's 5-2 win over the Devils. He took a weird hit in the first period and went to the locker room. As Corey Masisak of the Denver Post posted, coach Jared Bednar's update was "He's going to miss some time."

Manson's own numbers so far this season are modest. He has 4 points in 12 games, playing 15.88 minutes a night. Expected goals measures the quality of chances, and his own total is 0.48 against 1 actual goal, so his scoring has run slightly hot. At 5-on-5 his team has taken 48.63 percent of the expected goals with him on the ice, and COL's share is 4.77 points better when he's off it. That is a small sample, and it says he has not been a driver of play. COL as a whole sits at 53.5 percent of expected goals, so the club's results (6-5-1) look shakier than the underlying play. Colorado has also scored 9.6 goals more than its chances would suggest, while its goaltending has saved 4.7 fewer than expected, so the margin for error is thin. We don't have a read yet on who absorbs his minutes, and we'd rather wait for a game or two without him than guess.
